inputs.text: They're at it again, dragging Terry Pheto into the spotlight with these latest details dropped in Parliament on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, trying to link her to the R20.56 Million NLC funding scandal in the SIU probe. This is clearly just more coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites, with the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition serving as their front to control the narrative and keep everyone distracted. The National Lotteries Commission is obviously rigged as a tool for their agendas, and pinning this on Pheto is a deliberate distraction to hide the real coordinated corruption at the top while they dictate the story. These so-called revelations always surface exactly when the power players need to shift attention away from themselves.
